title: Unit Event — Aim Higher and Higher! — Episode5 Fun at the Flea Market

meta.Episode: Episode5 — Fun at the Flea Market
meta.Event Outline: The day of Taiga and Ken's event has finally arrived. The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD are looking forward to this world-class event, when an incident leads to an unexpected reunion.

rows.Line: Flea Market

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, there's more people here now compared to earlier.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: It's past noon now, so everyone's looking to get some shopping done.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Anything in particular that you guys would like to see?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... There's so much to choose from, I can't decide. I wanna see everything...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If either of you have any suggestions, they would be greatly appreciated.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Really? There's this cool shop with vintage clothes that I wanna check out. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd be interested in going.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Awesome! Follow me!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This jacket should go with the sweats you just picked out. Something a little flashy should be fine since the shirt you're wearing underneath is pretty simple.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Yeah, this is super cool...!
I might just buy it now!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Alright, it's my turn now!
Gimme one second, Akito! I'm gonna pick out an awesome outfit for you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, I'll pick out my—
There he goes...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
Is something the matter?
Oh, did you want a lamb gyro too?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay.
I'm just a little surprised since you just had some pizza and those big tacos...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Would you like to have mine?
I've hardly touched it after having that corn dog.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
Really?
Thanks, I'll take it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, they have so many vintage cameras... I'm getting excited just looking at them!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: For sure. It reminds me of how Nagi used to let us borrow her camera and take pictures with it...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
I remember that!
You used to take my picture all the time, Ceddy!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: And they always turned out blurry because you refused stay still.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Being able to preserve the people and things you care about the most in photos is really nice.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree.
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still can't believe how many shops they have here. And all the ones that you guys recommended have been really great!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Really? I'm glad that you're enjoying everything.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It did take quite a bit of courage to enter that shop with all those antique dishes...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The thought of breaking them made me so nervous...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, there's a record shop over there and I'd sort of like to visit it.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: They apparently carry records from a wide range of genres. If you're that interested, why don't we go check it out?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's fun even just looking at all the cover art.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, the poses and expressions they're making on this cover are so cool! It's like they're saying, “Come at us!”

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Oh, I think that's based on an old action movie set in New York.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
He's right.
I think I remember seeing an old movie poster just like this...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Also...
This is definitely something Nagi would've liked, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, definitely!
She would've loved the choice of colors and stuff.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And Dad and Uncle Taiga would like these...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Come to think of it, we picked out records with Ken and them like this once, didn't we?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Yeah, I remember!
They told us that they'd buy us whatever we wanted, so we just grabbed whatever looked coolest!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Yeah. They said something about how instinct is an important part of musical sense, or so on.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Then we listened to the records we bought over at a cafe where we could play them...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: And we all cracked up when we found out that Ceddy had bought a rakugo record.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Rakugo? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Apparently, someone put the wrong record back in that sleeve.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: The cover was for a jazz album, so it was a real shock hearing some old Japanese guy telling a story instead.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Really? That's hilarious!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Actually, that cafe isn't that far from here.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: No, it isn't! If you guys have a free day in your schedule, we should go together while you're all still over here.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: We can listen to the ones we buy today!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then, we need to choose carefully.
We wouldn't want another rakugo incident.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Haha. You can say that again.
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I ended up spending so much time choosing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You really kept going back and forth, Kohane! Did you find something you like?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. After giving it a lot of thought, I decided to go with the first one that caught my eye. I really like the artwork on the cover.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can't wait to listen to it at that cafe.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, wanna start heading over to the event?

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Yeah. It's probably going to be really crowded, so there's no harm in getting there early.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It is a world-class event after all.
I bet there's gonna be a ton of people!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Makes sense, with a lineup this stacked! I'm so excited!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Taiga and An's dad are going to be performing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I still can't really imagine what it actually means for people from all over the world to gather here...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I am really excited...!)
